decisions.reason: As a recently launched printer close to the core marking portfolio, it fits the firm’s stated path toward digitalized traceability, has already absorbed development and launch resources, and there is no clear evidence yet that weak early results are more than temporary.

The software module was publicly introduced as an extension of the digital inline printing portfolio, is strategically central to serialization and end-to-end traceability, and management would be inclined to justify that visible commitment by giving it more time.

This coder builds directly on the firm’s established technological base and customer needs for reliable marking on difficult surfaces, so in a growing firm and industry management would likely persist rather than abandon such a recent investment.
